head: ed8fd90
scope: R1-SCREEN-1023 uncommitted implementation; independent local synthetic probes and source/report inspection, not a complete acceptance or production check
source_confirmed_gaps: screen roots, lists, presets and API read/write calls do not bind server user/project scope; DSH also explicitly reports shared instance-level storage
public UI/API read a single server-configured cache; no user-upload dataset selection loop is present
latest conflicting period can fall back to an earlier period and still pass rules; explanatory notes do not make periods comparable
safeguards: All probe files generated inside a new TemporaryDirectory; WEAVEMIND_TEST_MODE enabled and SCREEN_DIR pointed to that test root. No production service/config/credentials/data mutation, network request, LLM call or git state change.
dispositions: R1 prototype has useful progress but is not fully accepted or production-ready. Next employee work must correct identity, integrity and scope first; do not deploy, commit or push without new explicit authorization.
